{{Quote|We lost the whole comm center, more or less intact, and most of the sector fleet supply depots. On the plus side, we didn't leave them any ships they could use. And we were able to make enough trouble on our way out to let General Kryll sneak Travia Chan and her people out from under the Imperials' collective snout.|Pash Cracken, on the New Republic evacuation of Generis|<ref name="TLC" />}}
'''Travia Chan''' was a military leader who resisted the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Fest/Legends|Fest]], led the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Atrivis Sector Force]], and continued serving the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]]. The [[Gender/Legends|woman]] led the [[Fest Resistance Group]] against their homeworld's [[Fest collaborationist government|collaborationist government]] and the Imperial occupation. When the neighboring [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine's]] "[[Mantooine Liberators|Liberators]]" tried to rally their world in revolt against the Empire, Chan and her people were powerless as they watched [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] [[Battle on Mantooine/Legends|massacring]] the Liberators&mdash;although Chan's group had known of the Imperials' presence, they had no established communication with the Liberators.

With strengthened determination, Travia Chan's group reached out to the surviving Mantooine Liberators and set out on uniting the Atrivis [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] scattered resistance into an underground network led by Chan herself as [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|commander-in-chief]]. Her effective and cool judgement in battle earned her the name "'''Icewoman'''" to her enemies, though she was known to fellow Rebels like her [[Chief of Staff/Legends|chief of staff]], Mantooine's [[Loom Carplin]], as '''Trav'''. The Atrivis Rebels' leadership were convinced to [[Treaty of Generis|join]] the larger [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after debating the costs and benefits promised by the Alliance [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|leader]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]. Based in the [[Generis system/Legends|Generis system]], the Atrivis Sector Force then played crucial roles in supply and communication under Chan's continued leadership, with their sector's struggles influencing the course of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] against the Empire.

==Biography==
===Imperial occupation===
[[File:Fest04.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Travia Chan was from Fest, home to one of the foremost resistance groups against the Imperial regime.]]
As a [[Youngling/Legends|child]], Travia Chan was afflicted by an illness that restricted her mobility. Chan consequently had to make use of a [[Repulsorlift chair/Legends|repulsorchair]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] was among the founders of the [[Fest Resistance Group]], streetfighters opposed to the [[Democracy/Legends|totalitarian]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Fest/Legends|Fest]]. Fest was a densely-populated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], to which the Empire assigned a token [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] presence, yet the Atrivis [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] culture of autonomy prompted the Outer Rim's foremost resistance movements to the new [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] regime after he [[Declaration of a New Order|declared]] himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|emperor]]<ref name="RASB" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Chan's group disrupted Imperial activity and denied resources to both the occupying power and [[Fest collaborationist government|Fest's collaborationist planetary government]], and they were hence regarded by the Empire as "[[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]]."<ref name="RASB" />

However, resistance was disunited even between neighboring groups due to mutual suspicions and historical disputes. The most prominent "terrorists" in the Atrivis sector were the [[Mantooine Liberators|Liberators]] on the lightly-populated planet [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]]. When they [[Battle on Mantooine/Legends|overran]] Mantooine's [[Imperial garrison post|Imperial garrison]] and urged all of Mantooine to join in revolt at some point<ref name="RASB" /> by [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Mantooine date">The [[Battle on Mantooine/Legends|massacre on Mantooine]] was mentioned in ''[[Rebel Dawn]]'', which is set in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] according to {{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=870#15782460|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-10-13|time=8:50 AM}}</ref> an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial strike fleet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the nearby [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of Fest massacred the Liberators. The Fest Resistance Group had known of the fleet's presence but had no communication established with the Mantooine Rebels<ref name="RASB" /> and could only watch the battle with regret, fear, but also increasing determination.<ref name="AoR">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> Chan therefore reached out to Mantooine's survivors from her undeterred Fest Resistance Group, uniting the two worlds' Rebels as the [[Atrivis Resistance Group/Legends|Atrivis Resistance Group]] (ARG). Chan served as the group's first and only [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|commander-in-chief]].<ref name="RASB" />

===Uniting the Rebels===
[[File:Loom_carplin.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Chan's chief of staff, Loom Carplin, a surviving member of the Mantooine Liberators]]
The ARG set up a [[Generis orbital base|hidden base]] at an abandoned [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the Atrivis sector's [[Generis system/Legends|Generis system]]. While Chan was confined to Generis base and its medical facilities, she oversaw an efficient underground network that expanded across the Atrivis sector's [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], collecting information and coordinating action against the Imperial establishment. Chan was supported by the Mantooine Liberators' veteran warrior [[Loom Carplin]] as her [[Chief of Staff/Legends|chief of staff]]. Carplin was a fellow Human who primarily monitored Resistance operations for Chan. Carplin also personally directed difficult missions on the front lines, and in lieu of his presence at Generis base, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] administrator [[Busurra]] acted as chief of staff with the aid of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[Language/Legends|translator]] [[C3-L1]]. The ARG leadership grew concerned about their lack of knowledge beyond their sector, fearing that the Empire could launch a major offensive against them from without<ref name="RASB" />&mdash;just as the Mantooine Liberators had been unaware of goings-on beyond their planet.<ref name="AoR" />

When the ARG leadership was approached by [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]&mdash;the [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|chief]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], which had united under a common [[Declaration of Rebellion/Legends|cause]] and structure in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the Imperial regime in 2 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]]<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>&mdash;the leaders were initially hesitant to cede control to outsiders and take on new responsibilities and risks. However, Mothma persuaded them of the benefits of joining the Rebellion's [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] communications network and the necessity of coordinated pan-galactic action against the Empire, and she promised the creation of the Rebels' [[Outer Rim Communications Center]] at Generis alongside the stationing of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], which the ARG had lacked. Following a mild argument weighing costs and benefits, the ARG leaders agreed to sign the [[Treaty of Generis]], joining the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="RASB" />

[[File:MonMothma-NEGTC.png|thumb|right|180px|Travia Chan's group signed the Treaty of Generis after being approached by Mon Mothma (pictured).]]
Travia Chan maintained her position as commander-in-chief of the ARG as it underwent a six-[[Standard month/Legends|month]] reformation period into the [[Atrivis Sector Force]], a semi-autonomous [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Force]] reporting to [[Sector Command (Alliance)/Legends|Alliance Sector Command]]. Sector Command's [[Advisor/Legends|advisory]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] helped the Atrivis group set up its liaison office while [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] trained the freedom fighters in [[Guerrilla warfare/Legends|guerrilla operations]], and Alliance [[Technician/Legends|technicians]], [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]], and [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilots]] oversaw the construction of the communications equipment and starfighter [[Hangar/Legends|docks]].<ref name="RASB" />

Conversely, the Atrivis Forces also influenced the wider Alliance. The sacrifice of the people of Mantooine that catalyzed the union of the Atrivis Forces under Chan had also hardened the resolve of early resistance leaders, including Mon Mothma,<ref name="Mantooine CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|287|Mantooine}}</ref> In the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station's]] destruction at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the construction of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] was secretly completed in the [[Horuz system/Legends|Horuz system]] of the Atrivis sector,<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> where the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Galen Marek]] [[Battle on Death Star I|infiltrated]] the battlestation to rescue the Alliance leaders therein.<ref name="TFUN">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>

===Organizing the Atrivis Sector Force===
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] between the Battle of Yavin and the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="RASB" /> three years later in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Travia Chan was in command of Generis base's [[Sector Headquarters]] as its [[Sector commander/Legends|sector commander]], and her chief of staff oversaw five branches of the Atrivis Forces: [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]], [[Procurement and Supply/Legends|Ordance and Support]], [[Fest Alliance Forces]], Mantooine Liberators, and other ground forces. The branch of Ordance and Support that Chan oversaw was important to the entire Alliance as the Atrivis sector was a prime [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] supplier for the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Armed Forces]].<ref name="RASB" />

[[File:Atrivis-TEA.png|thumb|left|300px|The Atrivis sector, in which Travia Chan directed the Rebel Sector Force]]
The Rebels' Atrivis Sector Headquarters also controlled the Outer Rim Communications Center's security, manpower, and supplies<ref name="RASB" /> on the planet [[Generis/Legends|Generis]],<ref name="TLC" /> but the ORCC was otherwise headed by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kryll]], directly answerable to Alliance Sector Command given the communication link's importance to the Alliance's Outer Rim command structure.<ref name="RASB" /> The ORCC coordinated Rebel communications throughout the northern sectors of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="AoR" /> Both the ORCC and Sector Headquarters were defended by Starfighter Command, headed by [[Wing Commander/Legends|Wing Commander]] [[Varth/Legends|Varth]]. His position in the chain of command was somewhat ambiguous as he answered to Chan for offensive operations in the sector, yet he also answered directly to Alliance Sector Command for the protection of the ORCC and to [[Starfighter Command (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Command]] for combined operations with other sectors' starfighters.<ref name="RASB" />

With Fest's heavily urbanized planet surface and an Imperial base in high orbit, the forces on Chan's homeworld were dispersed and had limited opportunities of communication and gathering en masse. Instead, they tried to make Imperial rule as costly as possible by acting within their assigned "hunting preserves," including [[Local day/Legends|nighttime]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] units who posed as law-abiding citizens in the day. The Fest Alliance Forces also operated in nearby systems but mainly targeted Fest citizens&mdash;the Rebels considered collaborating with a foreign power to oppress one's own people to be worse than foreign oppression itself&mdash;and the [[Fest police force]] consequently suffered from mass desertion, with the [[Fest military]] directly imposing the collaborationist government's authority. Commando teams occasionally received orders directly from [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] rather than from Chan for specific operations, and the relevant messages were passed via Fest's planetary entertainment [[HoloNet/Legends|holo-network]] and local news programs by Rebel [[Journalist/Legends|newscasters]].<ref name="RASB" />

[[File:Mantooine-RebelAllianceSourcebook.png|thumb|right|350px|Chan oversaw the Mantooine Liberators, who sustained an army in the wilderness of their homeworld.]]
On Mantooine, the Liberators fielded an army of several thousand Rebels that dominated the sparsely populated [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] countryside outside the [[City/Legends|cities]], which were occupied by the government's army, formed of unwilling conscripts and led by [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]]. The Empire valued Mantooine less than Fest, though Mantooine also had an [[Imperial orbital base]] until Alliance Special Forces destroyed it in [[Operation Cobolt]]<ref name="RASB" /> at some point between [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and 3 ABY.<ref name="Cobolt date">[[Operation Cobolt]] is mentioned in [[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]], which is set before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. The operation was planned by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion's]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]], who joined the Rebellion in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Chan could only supply part of what the Liberators needed from off-world, forcing the resource-strapped Rebels to rely on friendly villages and stealing from the government army.<ref name="RASB" />

===Battles across the Atrivis sector===
Between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Oplovis fleet date">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]], set in the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and therefore from [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], establishes that the [[Battle of the Generis system|Oplovis Sector Fleet attack]] involved [[Vernan (general)|Vernan]], who [[Death/Legends|died]] in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] according to ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''.</ref> Alliance Intelligence reported that the Imperial [[Oplovis Sector Fleet]] was likely planning to attack the Rebels on Mantooine by crossing from the adjacent [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]] into the Atrivis sector. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] thus promptly personally led three [[Ship of the line/Legends|ships of the line]] of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] to the Atrivis sector, [[Battle of the Generis system|ambushing]] the Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] upon its exit from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]<ref name="RASB" /> in the Generis system.<ref name="Oplovis fleet location">{{CSWECite|II|417|Oplovis sector}}</ref>

While the Fest and Mantooine forces received the most attention, the makeup of other ground forces under Chan's command varied, with typically one such force per system operating as guerrillas with the pretense of "random violence" that avoided drawing attention to the wider Rebel organization while achieving mission goals. While some of those forces in the Atrivis sector were deliberately set up by the Alliance, others formed spontaneously before joining the Alliance.<ref name="RASB" /> Chan's sector was the site of [[Atrivis sector uprising|uprising]],<ref name="Target">[[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']]</ref> Rebel [[132nd Forward Division|armed deployment]]<ref name="SETSB">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref> and [[Battle of Spefik|battle]],<ref name="RC1">[[River of Chaos 1|''River of Chaos'' 1]]</ref> including Alliance missions conducted outside the Sector Force's command.<ref name="RASB" /><ref name="DF">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref><ref name="Rogue">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref>

===The New Republic===
[[File:Battle_of_Generis.png|thumb|right|350px|Generis fell to Thrawn's Imperials. Travia Chan was among the people evacuated by the New Republic.]]
After the Rebel Alliance overthrew the Empire in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and began transitioning into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="NEC" /> Travia Chan was still working in<ref name="TLC" /> the Atrivis sector, which had been largely ruled by the anti-Republic [[Pentastar Alignment]] since 4 ABY,<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> when the [[Thrawn's confederation|forces]] of Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] [[Fall of Generis|attacked]] the New Republic on Generis in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], as part of a [[Thrawn campaign|wider campaign]] to restore Imperial rule. Although Thrawn's forces captured the Outer Rim Communications Center, Chan and her people were secretly evacuated by General Kryll as New Republic starfighters led by Captain [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]] and Varth engaged the Imperials.<ref name="TLC" />

==Personality and traits==
Travia Chan was a woman who, despite&mdash;or because of&mdash;her chronic physical frailty and aging, had a sharp wit and iron will. She was renowned for her cool and unemotive judgement under the most stressful military scenarios&mdash;her enemies called her the "Icewoman." The commander-in-chief was also known to fellow Rebels as "Trav."<ref name="RASB" />

==Skills and abilities==
Chan was a fine theoretical strategist who arranged the creation of the Atrivis Resistance Group from the Fest Resistance Group and the decimated Mantooine Liberators. As commander-in-chief, she oversaw the development of an effective and clandestine network of freedom fighters across the Atrivis sector and led it into the wider network of Mon Mothma's Rebel Alliance. Chan managed her people from the confines of her hidden base despite organizational complexities, with the Atrivis forces skilled in ground assaults and small squad tactics depending on the context of their particular situation. She was knowledgeable about [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and the inner workings of a [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]], as well as skilled in [[Computer/Legends|computer]] programming and repair.<ref name="RASB" />

==Equipment==
Chan wore a [[Clothing/Legends|shawl]] joined by a hexagonal brooch upon her chest. She sat on a repulsorchair and carried a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="RASB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Travia Chan was introduced in ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', authored by [[Paul Murphy]] with an illustration of Chan by [[Allen Nunis]]. The sourcebook was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1990]] for the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|first edition]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="RAS">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>
